title: Power Display: Won't start on start up automatically

judgment.rationale: Keep the primary Power Display symptom with #51387 and the existing IPC migration effort #50253. That open draft removes the fatal custom five-second handshake boundary, but a common mechanism and shipped resolution have not been independently demonstrated for this reporter. Do not fold the unrelated reset comment into that diagnosis.
evidence: The primary report's startup failure matches the Power Display timeout family tracked in #51387.
A separate comment about broader settings resets is not evidence that the startup timeout and all resets have one cause.
Read the complete report and separate commenter symptom.
Read #50253's current IPC migration patch and its removal of the custom five-second wait; the PR remains open and draft.
